description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that the order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1945/08 of 15.12.2015 effective from 16.12.2015 was passed by the Parliament on 10.03.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns regulatory amendments to the Excise Ordinance, specifically setting and modifying the permitted alcohol strength percentages for various liquor products. It constitutes a legal/regulatory notification issued under statutory authority, falling clearly under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
